name: CER-Intent Wireless Transport Slice
description: RFC 9543 network slice over Ceragon wireless transport. CER-Intent acts as the slice controller: it maps the request, chooses L2VPN or L3VPN and realizes it on TeraFlowSDN (L2SM RFC 8466 / L3SM RFC 8299). Radio and ACM settings decided by CER-Intent travel as TeraFlowSDN service settings.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: sliceId
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Identifier of the slice service (RFC 9543 slice-service/id).

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: networkSliceService
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Full RFC 9543 request (network-slice-services tree, draft-ietf-teas-ietf-network-slice-nbi-yang). When set, it is sent as is and the fields below are ignored.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: endpointA
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: First service demarcation point as node:port (e.g. pe-1:ge-0/0/1).

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: endpointB
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Second service demarcation point as node:port.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: endpointAddresses
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: IPv4 address/prefix of each endpoint, comma separated (needed for an L3VPN).

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: vlanId
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Access VLAN at both endpoints; the radio hops carry the slice on it.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: maxLatencyMs
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: One-way delay maximum SLO in milliseconds.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: realizationTechnology
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: L2VPN, L3VPN, or auto (CER-Intent's technology selector decides and reports why).

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: intentText
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Optional free-text intent for CER-Intent (e.g. 'keep latency under 5 ms during rain').

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: sliceControllerUrl
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: RFC 9543 interface of the slice controller (CER-Intent): <base>/restconf/data/ietf-network-slice-service:network-slice-services.

serviceSpecCharacteristic.name: realizationStatus
serviceSpecCharacteristic.description: Reported back: built, sent or failed, with the technology and the reason it was chosen.
